messages:
maria_support: FYI customer reported a sudden invoice spike this morning. dashboard shows ~12k tokens for the app, invoice shows ~38k. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/6792 :thinking_face:

ashley_billing: :eyes: any obvious metering deltas? account id?

maria_support: Acct ID ACME-22. Customer says their frontend retries on network errors. they claim they DIDN'T set an idempotency key.

kevin_ingress: That rings a bell — we recently tightened the gateway ACK window. If client retries and uses no idempotency key, we can end up recording multiple ingest events if upstream ACKs arrive back-to-back.

jonah_sre: Can you paste a sample request/headers from the logs? need request_id and whatever dedupe keys we emitted.

maria_support: Pulled logs for ACME-22, here's a condensed snippet:

```
2026-03-16T09:12:08.123Z INFO ingress request_id=rq_8b12 path=/v1/generate status=202 ak_ack=1 idempotency_key=null
2026-03-16T09:12:09.456Z WARN ingress request_id=rq_8b13 path=/v1/generate status=202 ak_ack=1 idempotency_key=null
2026-03-16T09:12:09.789Z INFO ledger write request_id=ledger_zz01 tokens=400 owner=ACME-22
2026-03-16T09:12:10.100Z INFO ledger write request_id=ledger_zz02 tokens=400 owner=ACME-22
```

maria_support: You can see two ledger writes for the same user back-to-back. client retried -> gateway accepted both -> ledger recorded both.

kevin_ingress: Gateway should dedupe on idempotency_key when present. When absent we fall back to best-effort duplicate suppression using a short sliding window. That window is TTL=1s right now. If the client's retry spacing is <1s we may still create duplicates if ack path races.

ashley_billing: So this is double-billing for the same logical request. Do we know how many duplicates?

jonah_sre: Quick query shows ~95 duplicate ledger writes for ACME-22 in the spike period, avg token per write 380 => ~36k unexpected tokens. Matches invoice delta.

maria_support: Customer's frontend SDK default retry is aggressive: retry after 200ms, up to 3 attempts. No idempotency header added.

kevin_ingress: Repro steps if you want to test locally:
```
# simulate client that retries without idempotency
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -sv -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
    -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-demo"
    -H "Content-Type: application/json"
    -d '{"prompt": "hello", "max_tokens": 50}' &
  sleep 0.2
done
```

kevin_ingress: On current infra that will sometimes produce multiple ledger writes for the same logical call.

ashley_billing: Short-term: we should issue a customer credit for the duplicate portion and mark this as billing-affecting. What's the rollback window we can safely dedupe retroactively?

jonah_sre: We can identify candidates by grouping ledger writes with same client IP, proxied user-agent, and close timestamps (<=2s). Not perfect but will find ~85% of duplicates in this class. I can run the grouping and produce a CSV to audit.

maria_support: I'll propose a credit for the duplicated tokens and include suggested client fix in the notice: set X-Idempotency-Key or increase client retry backoff.

ashley_billing: Sounds good. Also request a small infra change: increase our in-gateway dedupe TTL to 5s while we roll out stronger dedupe on ledger side. That should reduce immediate risk. @jonah_sre can you own a short postmortem and the CSV?

jonah_sre: On it. I'll also add a flag to the ledger write to include "ingress_request_id" to make cross-checking deterministic for new writes.

kevin_ingress: I'll put a hotfix to extend dedupe window to 5s in canary for the next hour and watch metrics. deploy-bot: deploy request submitted.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: gateway/dedupe-ttl bump -> 5s. monitor: /dashboards/ingress/dedupe

maria_support: Notifying ACME with provisional credit and repro summary. thanks team.

ashley_billing: After jonah posts CSV I'll calculate exact token credit and follow up with billing ops. Closing loop with customer within 24h. :white_check_mark:
